title: B002: Implement Kubernetes-interacting packages
summary: All 4 external review findings from greptile-apps[bot] are properly addressed: (1) stale ConfigMap cleanup via label-based listing and deletion in deleteStaleConfigMaps, (2-3) Annotations propagation added to EnsureDeployment and EnsureService mutate functions, (4) RunJob now uses desired.DeepCopy() before SetControllerReference to avoid mutating the caller's parameter. Each fix includes corresponding test coverage. All unit tests pass, go vet and go build clean.

tests_checklist.item: V1: All unit tests pass (config/, deployment/, job/)
V2: go vet passes on all changed packages
V3: go build passes on all changed packages
TE1: Happy path tested — stale CM deletion, annotation propagation, no-mutation
TE2: Edge cases tested — different base names don't interfere (config), empty OwnerReferences before/after (job)
TE3: Error cases tested — stale CM verified deleted via Get returning error
TE4: Tests are independent — each creates its own client and owner
TE7: Assertions specific — exact label key-value pairs, exact annotation values, exact OwnerReferences state

code_quality_checklist.item: Q1: deleteStaleConfigMaps is a focused helper with single responsibility
Q2: All new/changed functions under 20 lines
Q4: Clear naming — labelManagedBy, labelConfigOwner, labelConfigBaseName, deleteStaleConfigMaps

security_checklist.item: S5: No sensitive data exposed in logs or errors

architecture_checklist.item: Solution is minimal — each fix is the simplest correct approach
Label-based cleanup is idiomatic Kubernetes (label selectors for resource management)
DeepCopy usage consistent with other functions in the codebase

dry_yagni_checklist.item: No over-engineering — stale cleanup is a necessary fix, not speculative

fail_fast_checklist.item: Errors use fmt.Errorf with %w for proper wrapping

defensive_checklist.item: Label values derived from owner.GetName() and base name — no user-controlled injection
Range iteration uses index (for i := range) to avoid loop variable capture

suggested_improvements: Minor: deleteStaleConfigMaps could wrap Delete errors with client.IgnoreNotFound to handle the rare race where a stale ConfigMap is deleted between List and Delete (e.g., by a concurrent reconciler). Currently, the reconciler will simply retry on the next loop, so this is cosmetic rather than functional.
